original_card.question: Does one quantified step of the proposed #4100 all-size construction hold at its actual caller?
methods: Prove one missing implication with explicit quantified hypotheses.
Find an exact counterexample at the claimed interface boundary.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Identify the proposition and what would change downstream; do not equate a finite replay with a universal proof.

first_step.inspect: Read PROOF.md and AUDIT.md in #4100. Select one distinct obligation: CRT total repair, native/free-algebra lifting, precision/conditioning, or complete fixed-tape cost. This is an author-submitted proof, not an accepted unconditional theorem.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Check live handoffs; name one proposition, its caller, quantified domain and dependency closure. Independently prove the implication or exhibit a precise gap/counterexample. Prioritize CRT.md total repair or COMPLEX.md free-algebra lift only if unclaimed. Stop at the chosen obligation; do not substitute finite samples or root arithmetic for an all-size proof, or launch the complete package by default.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Finite supplier improvements are useful only under the retained transfer obligations.
allowed_variations: One CRT repair, native lift, precision/conditioning or tape-cost proposition, with its exact caller.
scope_change_triggers: Replacing a quantified obligation with another finite smoke test.
Treating archive intake, an author PASS receipt or a finite composed fixture as discharge of the universal hypotheses.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4100: proposed unconditional construction and finite checks, without independent acceptance.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent proof audit of one caller-bound all-size implication; all other premises remain explicit.

actual_scope: Write one #4174 Plan.placement (three reservoir sources to front u, front t, back b) as calls of BIT.md's ordinary interchange, the callee CRT.md section 3-4 bills at O(V H^{1-a}+V). Count placement and restoration calls, and evaluate BIT.md section 4's wrapper branch at the actual width H = r_max G, starting with p = 1310720, ell = 21 (H = 10752) and the #4174 production layout.
scope_change_reason: The card asks for one quantified #4100 step at its actual caller. This refines it to the reservoir side left open by #4377/#4650 open question 2 and pending #4938 open question 1: the ordinary-callee bill of the #4174 placement. BIT.md's theorem is used as stated, not reproved. The wrapper-branch threshold (parts iii-iv) was first delivered by James Reed's pending PR #4942, whose claim crossed this one; it is recomputed here and cited, not claimed as new. The new content is parts (i)-(ii), the six-call placement/restoration count and its 6x bill, plus the padding ranges (v) and the D-independent Remark 4.
bottleneck_link: Side result on the #4100 transfer obligations. It prices one inherited callee interface of the CRT route at its actual parameters. It does not change the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop after the six-call decomposition, the conditional bill, the exact wrapper branch threshold, the elementary-range inequality and the padding ranges at the two layouts. Do not reprove BIT.md, price the rest of the section 4 gadget, or claim a new kappa.
evidence: PROOF.md proves (i)-(ii) and (v), and recomputes #4942's (iii)-(iv). verify.py checks 12 exchange orders on dirty Placement fixtures, all 131072 minimal and 104864 production plans, the exact GL_64 order bounds and j(D) table, the wrapper branch at every E <= 311309, the radix lemma, the elementary inequality, the padding ranges and 13 rejection controls. It prints PASS_CRT_RESERVOIR_INTERCHANGE_BILL. Ten source mutations of sharp claims all fail.

open_questions.question: Does a direct binary exchange of H single-bit swaps meet the same bill on fixed tapes without the (q^E/2^H)^2 padding?
open_questions.why_it_matters: At the actual widths the literal BIT.md call pays up to 2^34 (minimal) or 2^74 (production) extra volume per call, and the a2 saving is absent anyway.
open_questions.first_step: Write one bit swap at positions i < j as one fixed-tape pass with a bounded buffer, and count its tape actions per record.
open_questions.blocked_by: Nothing; it needs a tape model, not new mathematics.

open_questions.question: What is the stage-0 constant C_0 of BIT.md's elementary q-digit swap?
open_questions.why_it_matters: By (iii)-(iv) it is the whole callee constant at every CRT layout with L < 2.77e9.
open_questions.first_step: Bound one q-digit transposition of two radix-q fields with intervening fields on a fixed tape inventory.
open_questions.blocked_by: BIT.md does not state the elementary algorithm in detail.
